secrets.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Maps API key for photorealistic 3D tiles + place search (client-exposed; restrict by HTTP referrer). Optional — app boots keyless on Esri imagery. Get it from Google Cloud Console.

secrets.name: CESIUM_ION_TOKEN
secrets.description: Cesium ion access token for ion-hosted Google 3D tiles / terrain (client-exposed; use a public assets:read token). Optional. Get it from cesium.com/ion.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for realtime voice control. Optional. Get it from platform.openai.com.

secrets.name: AISSTREAM_API_KEY
secrets.description: AISStream key for the live AIS vessels layer (server-side only). Optional. Get it from aisstream.io.

secrets.name: FIRMS_MAP_KEY
secrets.description: NASA FIRMS map key for live active fires (server-side only). Optional. Get it from firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key/.
